title: The Northgate Optical Satisfaction Guarantee
content:
Dispensed Northgate Optical eyewear may be returned for a refund. A return is accepted only when it is requested no later than the lens design's satisfaction return window — 90 calendar days on every design — after the dispensed date of the job. Days are counted as calendar days, the dispensed date being day 0, and a request on day 90 is within the window. The dispensed date relied on is the one in the system record of the eyewear job.

**What a return refunds.** A return refunds the net — the charge less every credit already posted against it — of every lens, option and remake charge of the job and, because every design's return includes the frame, of the frame as well. Each is refunded as a return refund credit against its own charge, to the member's original tender. Accepting the return closes the job as returned, with the return date as its closing date.

**After the window.** After the window the eyewear is not refundable, and problems are handled only under the eyewear guarantee's remake clauses.

## The 90-day window on the calendar (hypothetical dates)

| Dispensed | Return requested | Day | Accepted |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 January 2025 | 10 April 2025 | day 90 | yes |
| 10 January 2025 | 11 April 2025 | day 91 | no |
| 10 January 2025 | 10 January 2025 | day 0 | yes |

## Refund illustration (hypothetical charges)

A job carries a base-lens charge of 149.99 with a vision plan allowance of 54.99 against it, a frame charge of 160.00 with a 130.00 allowance, a light-adaptive charge of 80.00 and a remake charge of 0.00. A return within the window refunds 95.00 against the base-lens charge, 30.00 against the frame charge and 80.00 against the light-adaptive charge — 205.00 to the original tender. The allowances already credited are not refunded to the member.

## Points of judgement

- *Does a remake restart the 90 days?* No. The window runs from the dispensed date, which never moves with a remake.
- *Is the frame refunded on a return?* Yes, on every lens design.
